channel.title: ShopNow Kitchen guides
channel.description: Kitchen gear, explained like a friend would. Every claim traced to its source.

item.title: Is your meat thermometer telling you the right number?
item.description: How to use a meat thermometer so the reading means something: USDA target temperatures, probe placement, calibration, the difference between a probe's food-contact limit and its ambient rating, and what wireless specs like range and probe count really buy you.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance: what the maker's own page must agree with itself about, which accessories decide whether it replaces anything, and when a combo box is the right call.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs before you buy: what 'dishwasher safe' covers, what the counter really has to hold, and the maintenance facts listings leave out.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity: what quarts actually measure, the three other numbers that decide whether it fits, and how to read a title that oversells its own number.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: A plain-English comparison of basket-style and oven-style air fryers: what each shape does well, the depth and power numbers that actually decide between them, and how the appliances we track blur the line.
